result.reason: The redline adds several requested protections, including the professional-and-workmanlike standard, a twelve-month technology warranty, legal compliance, malicious-code protection, and software repair/replace/refund remedies. It nevertheless satisfies neither level because it lacks any express services duration, does not warrant service-deliverable conformity to documentation, and does not clearly extend the remedies to breach of the services warranty. The software conformance warranty is also weakened by an unrequested materiality qualification. Drafting is further impaired by tying the services refund reference to clause (b), adding unnecessary Specifications and industry-standards language, and retaining awkward disclaimer language concerning whether nonconformities can be corrected. The changes remain focused on warranty matters and do not negate unrelated commercial terms.
